# Cannot compute: CN code missing

I can't compute the embedded emissions because the ruleset requires the good's CN code, and the datasheet doesn't provide one.

## Input check

| Required input | Status | Value |
|---|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | **Missing** | Not stated |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | Provided | India (listed for all four CN codes) |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | Provided | 600 t |

## Why the CN code can't be inferred

The ruleset selects the SEE by CN code and country together. The description ("semi-finished steel product, continuously cast, carbon ~0.2%") matches more than one table row, and the Indian defaults differ widely:

- 7206 10 00 (ingots, iron/non-alloy steel): 2.64 tCO2e/t
- 7207 11 90 (semi-finished products, iron/non-alloy steel): 4.32 tCO2e/t

7207 11 90 looks closest, but its table description is truncated, so I can't confirm the product meets all its criteria (such as carbon threshold, cross-section and production method). Choosing one of these rows would be an estimate, which the ruleset doesn't allow.

## What's needed

**The confirmed CN code** for this product, from the customs declaration, commercial invoice or supplier classification. If it matches one of the table's CN codes, the calculation will be:

> Embedded emissions = SEE (CN code, India) × 600 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places

If the confirmed code isn't in the table, the figure still can't be computed under the supplied ruleset.
